description: This Java class 'ExpandedParameterDecoder' handles decoding and processing of HTTP query and form parameters, including splitting parameters based on styles and regex patterns, and logging errors during parsing.

classes.name: ExpandedParameterDecoder
classes.description: A utility class for decoding, splitting, and processing HTTP parameters, with support for regex-based splitting and logging.

methods.name: retrieveFormParameters
methods.description: Parses form parameters from a string, handling query string decoding and error logging.

methods.name: retrieveQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts query parameters from a URL string, returning parameters and raw string, with error handling.

methods.name: splitParameters
methods.description: Splits matched parameters based on their style and value, updating the matched parameters accordingly.

methods.name: splitOnDelimiter
methods.description: Splits parameter values based on a regex style, handling quoted and JSON values, returning split values.
